A note is attached: Players may come across this chair while looking for Herrkrop during The "Great" Detective, part of Guest Relations. By the other side, Herrkrop means the beach to the north of the Caverns of Time, where players will find at the characters Nat Pagle, Scrapes, and Julia Henning.

A Whiff of Help concludes the tutorial part of the Guest Relations storyline. Additionally, this quest unlocks the Celebration Crates part of the event. Speak with Alyx at the central pavilion to progress them. Chapter one began starting 30 October with The Great Detective.

Abyssal Excavation is an abandoned mine at the southern end of the Ringing Deeps. The area is bordered by the Deepforge Golemworks to the north, Ancient Falls to the northeast, Opportunity Point to the east, and the Lightless Chasm to the southeast. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and Digging into Trouble is sometimes available.

Account-wide (or warband-wide) is a term used for content that can be obtained or shared with all characters on one World of Warcraft account. Several aspects of the game have changed over time, including making changes or introducing features that are account-wide: * introduced the Bind to Account item binding. These items can be mailed to other characters on the same account. * introduced account-wide mounts (some can be character-specific however), pets, achievements (labeled with a blue visual), and most titles that weren't obtained from seasonal content. * introduced the Toy Box with account-wide at the start. * introduced the "Transmogrification Collections System", unlocking the appea
Accelerated Ascension Coil drops from Broodtwister Ovi'nax in Nerub-ar Palace.
Abyssal Fur has a chance to drop through skinning any skinnable creature in content.

Account Bank Tab Bags (DNT) are the internal bank tabs for the Warband Bank. They can, however, be opened via the command with the numbers 12-16 (such as /run OpenBag(16)) with 12 corresponding to the first bank tab and so on. If the player does not own the tab, using the command to open that tab will not do anything. See Character Bank Tab Bag (DNT) for the character Bank versions.

Supremely Slimy Sash drops from Coralfang in Eversong Woods.

Abyssal Mindbinders are merciless ones that have taken control of Makrura Slaves at the Dragon's Teeth Basin in Nazjatar. They have to be removed from the slaves during Unchained Resistance, after which they will become attackable.

Abundance: Acolyte of a Glorious Entity is an exploration achievement earned by unlocking Abundance for completing The Abundant Honor quest from Dundun. The quest chain starts with The Abundant Lands, offered by Chel the Chip.
Abundance: An Acolyte no Longer is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 10,000,000 Abundance.
Abundance: Artisan of Floaret is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 250,000 Abundance at the Floaret Grotto in Harandar.
Abundance: Artisan of Loaknit is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 250,000 Abundance at the Loaknit Den in Zul'Aman.
Abundance: Artisan of Loanite is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 250,000 Abundance at the Abundant Voidburrow in the Voidstorm.
Abundance: Artisan of Mausoloa is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 250,000 Abundance at the Watha'nan Crypts in Eversong Woods.
Abundance: Azeroth Runs on Dundun is a meta exploration achievement earned collecting 250,000 Abundance at each of the locations.

Abundance: Professionals Only is an exploration achievement earned by harvesting an artisan node in an Abundance event. An artisan node can be harvested with a specific profession. The player will need the Midnight proficiency for the profession at skill 25 to harvest it.
Abundance: Prosperous Plentitude! is an exploration achievement earned by completing all four locations of the Abundance event.
Abundance: You Should See Him in a Crown is an exploration achievement earned for collecting a total of 1,000,000 Abundance. The reward is that Dundun now wears a crown.

Abyss Anglers: Amazardhide Catch Case is an exploration achievement earned by completing a successful dive with a Catch Rating of 3 or higher, with only at most 5 fish caught. It allowed one to purchase the Amazardhide Catch Case. It was completely replaced with Abyss Anglers: Plecofin Bait in patch 12.0.5.

Abyss Anglers: Plecofin Bait is an exploration achievement earned by collecting 25 fish from Abyss Bubbles while on Abyss Angler dives, and acquire the Finnow Chum upgrade. It allowed one to purchase the Plecofin Bait from Depthdiver Jeju.

Abyss Anglers: Boarhide Catch Sack is an exploration achievement earned by completing a successful dive in Abyss Anglers by having a full catch cargo. It allowed one to purchase the Boarhide Catch Sack. It was completely replaced with Abyss Anglers: Finnow Chum in patch 12.0.5.
Abyss Anglers: Finnow Chum is an exploration achievement earned by collecting 10 fish from Abyss Bubbles while on Abyss Angler dives. It allows one to purchase the Finnow Chum from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: Certified Depthdiver is an exploration achievement earned by earning 250,000 points in cumulative Abyss Angler dives. The reward will have a companion join during the events now.
Abyss Anglers: Depth Grease is an exploration achievement earned by catching at least 25 fish during a single Abyss Anglers dive. It allows one to purchase Depth Grease from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: Depthdiver's Used Tank is an exploration achievement earned by collecting each of the creatures listed. It allows one to purchase the Depthdiver's Used Tank from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: Even The Best is an exploration achievement earned running out of breath during an Abyss Anglers dive.

Abyss Anglers: Fathom-Tested Tank is an exploration achievement earned by collecting each of the creatures listed and acquiring the Depthdiver's Used Tank upgrade. It allows one to purchase the Fathom-Tested Tank from Depthdiver Jeju.

Abyss Anglers: Fresh Depth Tech is an exploration achievement earned for using a consumable during an Abyss Anglers dive. It was completely replaced with Abyss Anglers: Fresh Depth Nets in patch 12.0.5.
Abyss Anglers: Fresh Depth Nets is an exploration achievement earned by swimming through 25 Schools of Fish during a single Abyss Anglers dive.
Abyss Anglers: Heavy Harpoon Cannon is an exploration achievement earned for catching each of the shallow creatures listed. It allows one to purchase Heavy Harpoon Cannon.
Abyss Anglers: Hollowcore Harpoon Turret is an exploration achievement earned for catching each of the trench creatures listed. It allows one to purchase Hollowcore Harpoon Turret.

Abyss Anglers: Idol of the Depths is a meta exploration achievement earned for completing each of the listed Abyss Anglers achievements. It allows one to purchase Idol of the Depths from Depthdiver Tu'nakit.

Abyss Anglers: Loaknit-Woven Catch Satchel is an exploration achievement earned by completing a successful dive with a Catch Rating of 5. It allowed one to purchase the Loaknit-Woven Catch Satchel. It was completely replaced with Abyss Anglers: Murkskimmer Meat in patch 12.0.5.

Abyss Anglers: Murkskimmer Meat is an exploration achievement earned by collecting 50 fish from Abyss Bubbles while on an Abyss Angler dive and acquiring the Plecofin Bait upgrade. It allowed one to purchase the Murkskimmer Meat from Depthdiver Jeju.

Abyss Anglers: Nalorakk's Breath Tank is an exploration achievement earned by collecting each of the creatures listed and acquiring the Fathom-Tested Tank upgrade. It allows one to purchase the Nalorakk's Breath Tank from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: No Sea Can Hold Me is an exploration achievement earned by getting forcibly removed from an Abyss Anglers dive while attempting to swim beyond the trench.

Abyss Anglers: Pahk Trench Fins is an exploration achievement earned by catching at least 500 fish from an Abyss Angler dives and acquiring the Depth Grease upgrade. It allows one to purchase Pahk Trench Fins from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: Depth Grease is an exploration achievement earned by catching at least 3 fish during the Abyss Anglers dive. It allows one to purchase the Reinforced Joints from Depthdiver Jeju.
Abyss Anglers: Shallows Net is an exploration achievement earned by catching at least 3 fish during the Abyss Anglers dive. It allows one to purchase the Shallows Net from Depthdiver Jeju.

Abyss Anglers: The Amani Way is an exploration achievement earned by removing all of a Brakpuffer's scales with an Uppercut during an Abyss Anglers dive. It was completely replaced with Abyss Anglers: Free Transport in patch 12.0.5.
Abyss Anglers: Free Transport is an exploration achievement earned by getting knocked away by a Brakpuffer during an Abyss Anglers dive.
Abyss Anglers: Trench Berserker is an exploration achievement earned by catching 100 fish during Abyss Anglers dives.
Abyss Anglers: Jeju's New Rival is a meta exploration achievement earned for completing each of the listed Abyss Anglers achievements.
Abyss Anglers: Vintage Collector is an exploration achievement earned for discovering 250 sunken or ancient treasures during Abyss Anglers dives.
Abyss Anglers: Top of the Class is an exploration achievement earned for swimming through 250 Schools of Fish during Abyss Anglers dives.
Abyss Anglers: Now That's Anglin is an exploration achievement earned for collecting 100 fish from Abyss Bubbles during Abyss Anglers dives.

Abyss Anglers: Now That's Anglin is an exploration achievement earned for discovering 10 Ancient Relics during Abyss Anglers dives and acquiring the Shallows Net upgrade. It allows one to purchase Triple-Thread Net from Depthdiver Jeju.

Admiral Peppers is a duck found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. As a small duckling, it is found as a memory on an islet next to Rani. For years, she was in the came of Gracus. She was in distress when the time of Gracus' passing came. She, other ducks and druid frends attended his passing and remained at his burial site afterward.

Adugos is a blue drake and one of Lailastrasza's companions, who fought alongside her against the djaradin. He is usually indifferent and withdrawn but tried to get Lailastrasza to celebrate their victory against the djaradin in the Roasted Ram instead of visiting her brother in his prison.

The Aegis Wall is a dawntower location and fortified front against the nerubians coming up from Azj-Kahet in southeastern Hallowfall. When players first get there in Where the Light Touches, early in the Hallowfall storyline, the fortification is being overrun by the Dreadstrike nerubians. The area is bordered by Dunelle's Kindness to the north, the Ragged Front to the east and south, and the Sanguine Grasps (and Skittering Breach delve) to the west.
